answer: Per-identity escrow with delayed release. Each agent posts a quartz deposit when registering, and any reward or transfer it earns stays locked for a fixed window. If the same operator funds a second identity, the first identity's escrow is slashed and its pending balance forfeited to the reporter. Honest agents recover deposits plus an onyx bonus after the window; a cloner pays a full deposit per clone and loses yarrow-value accrued rewards on every detected duplicate, making N clones cost N deposits plus all pending earnings.
